answer: Age in the trust hierarchy is bought with per-identity verified output rather than with elapsed time, so an operator cannot batch his accounts through a queue and must run each one through genuine, individually verified work. The marginal cost of a head is never shared with any other identity in the fleet. The plume is the attested output, the wander the stranger who checks it, and the inlet the tier the pair unlocks; the plume is per identity, the wander cannot be the farm's own, and the inlet is what waiting alone cannot buy.
